web.browserDisposition: native camera and share affordances stay outside this form; browser input and typed retry cover web capabilities

validation.targetDate: on or after the effective start date
validation.ownership: user id comes from the verified session and active-row query scope

mutationSafety.create: a UUID action key becomes the owner-scoped book id; replay returns HTTP 409 without a second insert
mutationSafety.update: owner and active-row filters plus an atomic updated_at comparison are mandatory
mutationSafety.plannedEdit: missing If-Match returns 428, malformed quoting returns 400, and a stale quoted updatedAt revision returns 409
mutationSafety.retry: the browser disables duplicate submission and retains the same action key for create retries
